uz: Releli himoyaning to'rt asosiy talabi bor: selektivlik (tanlovchanlik), tezkorlik, sezgirlik va ishonchlilik. Yaxshi himoya shu to'rttasini birga ta'minlaydi.
en: Relay protection has four key requirements: selectivity, speed, sensitivity and reliability. Good protection provides all four together.

uz: Kompressor pichoqlari kirishdan chiqishga tomon kichrayib boradi — havo siqilib zichlashgani sari kichikroq hajm kerak bo'ladi.
en: Compressor blades get smaller from inlet to outlet — as air is compressed and gets denser, less volume is needed.

uz: 'Emissions' (chiqindilar) — NOx, CO va CO₂. Zamonaviy stansiyalar ularni past ushlash uchun DLN combustor va monitoring tizimlaridan foydalanadi.
en: 'Emissions' include NOx, CO and CO₂. Modern plants use DLN combustors and monitoring systems to keep them low.

q: Black start qobiliyati nima uchun muhim?
options: To'r o'chganda stansiya o'zini toksiz ishga tushiradi
explain: Total blackoutdan keyin tashqi toksiz ishga tushib, to'rni tiklashga yordam beradi.

uz: 'Baseload' rejimida stansiya doim to'liq quvvatda ishlaydi — bu eng samarali va jihoz uchun eng yumshoq rejim, chunki harorat o'zgarishlari kam.
en: In 'baseload' mode a plant runs at full power continuously — the most efficient and gentlest mode for equipment, since temperature swings are few.

uz: 'Level transmitter' (sath datchigi) bak yoki barabandagi suyuqlik sathini o'lchaydi. Bug' barabanida sath nazorati juda muhim — suv kam yoki ko'p bo'lsa xavfli.
en: A level transmitter measures liquid level in a tank or drum. Level control in a steam drum is critical — too little or too much water is dangerous.

uz: 'Borescope inspection' — turbinani ochmasdan, ingichka kamera (borescope) orqali ichki pichoqlarni ko'zdan kechirish usuli. Bu vaqt va xarajatni tejaydi.
en: A borescope inspection checks internal blades through a thin camera (borescope) without opening the turbine — saving time and cost.
